title: FOUNDRY / REAL CENTER
one_line: Turn lived uncertainty into manipulable state, transform it deliberately across media, and get evidence back without losing identity, provenance, or the path home.
end_state: An instrumented environment for turning thought into capability: distinctions become executable relations; relations acquire media; media produce consequence; consequence returns as evidence; evidence expands future controllability.
target_test: After this move, can more useful states be reached with better information and fewer brittle dependencies?

signature_laws.meaning: Abstraction must return to source, evidence, material or lived consequence.

signature_laws.law: ONE THING, MANY LAWFUL READINGS, FEW LAWFUL TRANSFORMATIONS
signature_laws.meaning: Projection may vary radically; identity and allowed change remain explicit.
A thing is not the file, screen, room coordinate or view that currently exposes it.
Vocabulary may change when the operational relation survives and can still return.
Eventually something must move, render, sound, print, fit, communicate, measure or change.
Establish a useful bounded primitive and fallback before machinery gains authority.

signature_laws.law: NO NEW CORE WITHOUT A MISSING FUNCTION
signature_laws.meaning: Novel structure must buy capability, not merely rename an existing relation.

signature_laws.law: DEPTH ↑ WHILE VISIBLE SURFACE AREA STAYS SMALL
signature_laws.meaning: Complexity belongs in the substrate; the active human control surface stays bounded.

signature_laws.law: RETURN IS PART OF THE OPERATION
signature_laws.meaning: Output without an observed delta, receipt or path home is incomplete.

convergences.label: IMAGE ↔ MATERIAL
convergences.claim: Visual generation becomes a fabrication and spatial-thinking instrument rather than chat-only imagery.
convergences.enters: generated image · photograph · diagram · mark · surface condition
convergences.consequence: physical surface, part, stencil, layout, spatial decision or reusable visual donor

convergences.label: SYMBOL ↔ OPERATOR
convergences.claim: Glyphs, names and compact notation become executable distinctions instead of decorative semantics.
convergences.enters: glyph · token · term · address · grammar · path
convergences.consequence: recoverable semantic operation with explicit invariants

convergences.label: STATE ↔ TRANSFORM ↔ MACHINE
convergences.claim: Formal state and continuous transformation meet a transaction boundary that can drive software or physical machinery.
convergences.enters: state token · coordinate · constraint · gesture · law
convergences.transform: compose discrete meaning with continuous transform → gate consequence → emit trace
convergences.consequence: machine-readable packet, applied change, proof trace and RETURN

convergences.label: WORLD ↔ SENSE ↔ ACT
convergences.claim: The house and workshop are reality gates where models must survive geometry, devices, materials, animals, people and measurement.
convergences.enters: room · object · device · air/water · cat · tool · observed condition
convergences.transform: sense/manual observe → address → model state → decide → actuate/rearrange/repair
convergences.consequence: world state changes and remains inspectable

convergences.label: READ ↔ TIME ↔ ATTENTION ↔ BODY
convergences.claim: Reading and planning become temporal/embodied projections over stable source identity rather than static page layouts.
convergences.enters: text · task · path · sequence · pulse · attention state
convergences.consequence: faster or clearer traversal with source identity intact

convergences.label: INTENT ↔ OTHER ↔ RETURN
convergences.claim: Private intention crosses into human or agent action only through explicit drafting, policy, authority and review boundaries.
convergences.transform: address → bound authority → draft/route → human review → transport/action
convergences.consequence: communication or delegated action with provenance and return path

convergences.label: RESOURCE ↔ TOOL ↔ WORLD
convergences.claim: Shopping and salvage are capability acquisition: resources are admitted by the transformations they enable, not by ownership or novelty.
convergences.enters: need · owned object · candidate purchase · donor mechanism · missing capability
convergences.transform: query → compare → verify → acquire/salvage → receive → test → adopt
convergences.consequence: a new physical/digital affordance attached to a real workflow

convergences.label: RECOVERY ↔ LINEAGE ↔ REIFY
convergences.claim: Past experiments remain donor material until an exact mechanism fills a current missing function.
convergences.enters: chat artifact · old app · branch · image · source pack · abandoned mechanism
convergences.transform: recover exact → address lineage → diff mechanism → transfer only missing function
convergences.consequence: current head gains capability without silent merge or archaeology-driven scope expansion

admission_gate: A real object, uncertainty or missing function can be named.
The proposed transformation produces an observable state change in a bounded horizon.
Failure leaves reusable information, artifact residue or a cheaper option.
The move adds less persistent dependency than the capability or uncertainty reduction it buys.
A RETURN receipt can state what changed and whether the result still serves the larger front.

corpus_policy.rule: Inventory may grow without increasing control cardinality. Corpus membership never grants execution priority or canonical status.

canonical_unit.shape: { identity, address, state_in, transform, projection?, act?, state_out, evidence, reversibility, provenance, return }
canonical_unit.note: Different media omit or specialize fields, but must not erase the path from source to consequence and back.
